dispatch_jobs.reason: U2 jacket water temperature rose from 162F to 184F over ~9 minutes starting ~4:20 PM. It kept rising after load was cut from 85% to 60%; U1 and U3 steady at ~162F. U2 put through a controlled stop at 4:29 PM ahead of the trip. Ambient 15F. Gas control needs U2 back for peak demand if it can safely run.
